input_claim_schema.timestamp: ISO8601 string or null (null = missing timestamp edge case)
input_claim_schema.source_id: string — name of the originating source
input_claim_schema.source_reliability: float 0.0–1.0 — prior reliability of this source
input_claim_schema.label: enum: SUPPORTS | REFUTES | NOT ENOUGH INFO
input_claim_schema.subject: string — entity the claim is about
input_claim_schema.notes: string — dataset annotation (not available to agents at runtime)

memory_store_entry_schema.subject: string
memory_store_entry_schema.sources: list of source_ids that support this value
memory_store_entry_schema.corroboration_count: int — number of independent sources agreeing

change_log_entry_schema.action: enum: ACCEPTED | UPDATED | DOWNGRADED | REJECTED | FORGOTTEN | MERGED
change_log_entry_schema.confidence_delta: float — change in confidence (positive or negative)
